title: Quick multiplication
explanation: 7 × 7 = 49. A quick check: 7 × 5 = 35, plus 7 × 2 = 14, gives 49.

title: A dozen dozens
body: Squares you should know by heart.
explanation: 12 × 12 = 144, also called a gross. Check: 12 × 10 = 120, plus 12 × 2 = 24, gives 144.

title: A quarter of 80
explanation: 25% is one quarter. 80 ÷ 4 = 20.

title: Multiplying decimals
explanation: Half of a half is a quarter: 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25.

title: Adding fractions
explanation: Add the tops when the bottoms match: 1/4 + 1/4 = 2/4 = 1/2. The bottom number does not change.

title: Square roots
explanation: 9 × 9 = 81, so the square root of 81 is 9.

title: Is it prime?
explanation: 17 can only be divided exactly by 1 and 17, so it is prime.

title: A tricky prime
explanation: 5 + 1 = 6, which divides by 3, so 51 divides by 3: 51 = 3 × 17.

title: Solve for x
explanation: Subtract 5 from both sides: 3x = 15. Divide by 3: x = 5.

title: Solve for x again
explanation: Add 4 to both sides: 2x = 14. Divide by 2: x = 7.

title: Up 10%, down 10%
statement: A 10% rise then a 10% fall brings a price back to where it started
explanation: 100 up 10% is 110. 110 down 10% is 110 − 11 = 99. The fall is taken from a bigger number.

title: Triangle angles
statement: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°
explanation: In any flat triangle the three inside angles always add up to 180°.

title: Times eleven
explanation: Put the sum of the digits in the middle: 1, (1 + 3), 3 gives 143.

title: Dividing by a half
explanation: Dividing by 0.5 means asking how many halves fit in 45. That is 90. Dividing by a half doubles a number.

title: Finding the average
explanation: Add them: 4 + 8 + 12 = 24. Divide by how many there are: 24 ÷ 3 = 8.

title: Negative times negative
explanation: A negative times a negative is positive: (−3) × (−4) = 12.

title: Area of a square
statement: A square with 5 cm sides has an area of 20 cm²
explanation: Area = side × side = 5 × 5 = 25 cm². 20 cm is its perimeter (4 × 5), not its area.

title: Swapping percentages
explanation: x% of y always equals y% of x. Here both are 10.

title: Dividing by eight
explanation: Halve three times: 1,000 → 500 → 250 → 125.

title: Two answers
statement: x² = 49 has only one solution, x = 7
explanation: (−7) × (−7) is also 49, so there are two solutions: 7 and −7.

title: Order of operations
body: Brackets, powers, times and divide, plus and minus.
explanation: Multiply before adding: 3 × 4 = 12, then 2 + 12 = 14. You only get 20 with brackets: (2 + 3) × 4.

title: Multiply by 11 in your head
body: For a two-digit number, write its digits apart and put their sum in the middle. 34 × 11: 3, (3 + 4 = 7), 4 gives 374. If the sum is 10 or more, carry 1 to the left: 57 × 11 is 5, 12, 7, so 627.

title: The percentage swap trick
body: x% of y equals y% of x. Hard ones become easy: 8% of 25 is the same as 25% of 8, which is 2. And 4% of 75 is 75% of 4, which is 3.

title: Squaring numbers ending in 5
body: Take the first digit, multiply it by the next number up, then write 25 after it. 35²: 3 × 4 = 12, so 1,225. 65²: 6 × 7 = 42, so 4,225.

title: Multiply by 5 quickly
body: Multiplying by 5 is the same as multiplying by 10 and halving. 5 × 68: 680 ÷ 2 = 340. 5 × 43: 430 ÷ 2 = 215.

title: What is a prime number?
body: A prime number is a whole number greater than 1 that can only be divided exactly by 1 and itself: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13... The number 2 is the only even prime. 1 is not prime.

title: The order of operations
body: Work in this order: Brackets, then powers, then multiply and divide from left to right, then add and subtract from left to right. So 10 − 2 × 3 = 10 − 6 = 4, not 24.

title: Solving a simple equation
body: Whatever you do to one side, do to the other, until x is alone. 4x + 3 = 23: take 3 from both sides (4x = 20), then divide both sides by 4 (x = 5). Check: 4 × 5 + 3 = 23.

title: Working out a percentage change
body: Percentage change = (new − old) ÷ old × 100. A price going from 80 to 100: (100 − 80) ÷ 80 × 100 = 25% rise. Always divide by the starting value.

title: Divisible by 3 or 9?
body: Add the digits. If the sum divides by 3, the number divides by 3. If the sum divides by 9, the number divides by 9. 2,457: 2 + 4 + 5 + 7 = 18, so it divides by both 3 and 9.

title: Mean, median and mode
body: Mean: add everything and divide by the count. Median: the middle value when sorted. Mode: the most common value. For 2, 3, 3, 8, 14: mean 6, median 3, mode 3. One big value pulls the mean but not the median.

title: Estimate before you calculate
body: Round first to see the rough answer: 49 × 21 is about 50 × 20 = 1,000. The exact answer (1,029) should be close. If your calculation gives 10,290, you know something went wrong.

title: Logic: the Monty Hall puzzle
body: A prize is behind one of 3 doors. You pick one. The host, who knows, opens another door with no prize and lets you switch. Switching wins 2 times in 3, because your first pick was right only 1 time in 3.

title: Zero as a number
body: The Indian mathematician Brahmagupta wrote rules for calculating with zero, including adding and subtracting it, in 628 CE. Treating zero as a number in its own right was a huge step for mathematics.

title: Pi never ends
body: Pi (π), the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter, is about 3.14159. It is irrational: its decimals go on forever without repeating, so it can never be written exactly as a fraction.

title: The birthday paradox
body: In a room of just 23 people, there is a better than 50% chance that two of them share a birthday. It feels wrong, but there are 253 different pairs of people to compare.

title: What is a googol?
body: A googol is 1 followed by 100 zeros (10¹⁰⁰). The name was coined by a young boy, the nephew of mathematician Edward Kasner, in the 1920s. The company name Google was inspired by it.
